title: Bob the Builder
description: Bob the Builder and his machine team are ready to tackle any project. Bob and the Can-Do Crew demonstrate the power of positive thinking, problem-solving, teamwork, and follow-through. The team always shows that “The Fun Is In Getting It Done!”

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines are in great demand after a heavy storm causes destruction. Meanwhile, at the farm Muck and Lofty find it hard to cope when a fallen tree by the pond traps Pilchard and a family of ducks.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines are painting line-markings on the road. Bob is called away to repair Mrs Potts' garden fence. Spud then sees a way to make mischief! He attaches the line-marking machine to Travis. Travis then speeds off and doesn't know he is leaving a mess. Who will stop him before he paints the whole town white?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Roley nearly flattens a family of hedgehogs who are crossing the road Bob and the machines are working on. They need to find a permanent solution. How will hedgehogs get across a busy road?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines are laying pipes in a field. Meanwhile, Wendy tries to look for Pilchard and gets in a panic when she can't find her anywhere.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines are repairing a tunnel. Bob sends Muck inside carrying a load of bricks. The generator breaks down and the lights go out. Poor Muck is stuck inside the dark tunnel. What can make him move?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines have a major job of resurfacing the main road that must be done today. But poor Bob has a very bad cold. Wendy offers to take over the job. All goes well until Dizzy gets stuck in some wet cement. How will they get her out without letting Bob know?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Bob finds a bit of pipe that he thinks makes a noise like a trumpet and so he fashions it into a bugle. While learning to play it, he doesn't realise that it makes an awful noise!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines are building a dance floor stage ready for a line-dancing contest that evening. Bob needs to go home for some final practice. But when his dancing partner Mavis sprains her ankle, will Bob find someone else to dance with in time?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Scoop and Travis decide to have a race to find out who is fastest? Bob prepares the racecourse. Spud wants Travis to win so he tries some sneaky sabotage to keep Scoop back!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Wendy and the machines decide to pretend to have forgotten Bob's birthday and then surprise him with a party. Wendy goes home to make a cake, and then Muck and Dizzy decide to make a concrete cake for Bob to keep forever.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines are finishing Travis' new shed. Spud wants to pick go apple-picking but cannot reach the apples from the trees. While Bob is working on the shed roof, Spud takes the ladder away. How will poor Bob ever get down?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Spud is worried he is not scary enough anymore after he tries to scare Bird. His problems get worse when he loses his turnip nose and it falls into a mole hole. Muck and Dizzy try to help him find a suitable new nose. Will Spud ever be scary again?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines have to repair Farmer Pickles' barn which is in danger of collapsing. Farmer Pickles is gathering the haystacks. Everything has to be done before a heavy storm breaks.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Whilst chasing rabbits in a field, Scruffty falls down a hole. Muck is spooked by the noises he makes and thinks it's a ghost. He calls Bob to have a look and then Lofty hauls Scruffty out of the hole.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: When Mr Bentley gets soaked whilst inspecting a pipe, Spud decides to take over his job, even though he has no qualifications!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Bob is building a hen coop for Farmer Pickles as his hen has abandoned her eggs. Spud decides to look after the chicks.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Wendy is holding a barbeque party for her sister Jenny who is coming to visit in which the whole town is invited. However, the machines are too tired to go after laying a garden path.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Spud builds a skateboard out of an old ironing board at the rubbish dump and heads through town! Bob has just put up some traffic calming measures.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Wendy takes Muck and Dizzy to clear a blocked drain. Muck is spooked by the gurgling noises. Dizzy convinces him that it is a drain monster!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: When Mrs Percival has the school yard full of props for the school play, Spud decides to borrow the dragon costume. He pretends to be a magic dragon when he sees Muck.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: When Scoop notices that Farmer Pickles has entered Scruffty into the dog show, he becomes determined to enter Pilchard, even though she's a cat!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Bob, Mr Bentley and the machines are building a bird hide at the nature reserve and then waiting to catch a glimpse of the rare Grebe Warbler. But instead they see Spud disguised as the bird!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Bob's Auntie Dora, who is a stickler for tidiness, is planning to visit and the yard is in a complete mess. The machines only make it worse.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Spud decides to skate on the duck pond when it is frozen over, but the ice starts to crack! Dizzy calls on Bob and Lofty to come to the rescue.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Roley nearly runs over Bob's toolbox. He then worries that he is always very clumsy. His anxiety makes him more accident-prone than ever!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 5 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: It's winter in Littletown. Bob wears a big parka that makes him looks like an eskimo. Wendy's Sister Jenny comes for a visit after a Ski Trip.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Bob starts a pizza delivery service while Wendy and the machines build a bike path.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Bob buys a metal detector to look for treasure while Wendy and the machines build a car wash.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Mr Beasley has a huge disaster.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Wendy starts a removal service.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Lofty finds a family of rabbits.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Lofty finds a giant carrot & gets scared.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The whole town is practising for an egg and spoon race. Spud has problems keeping his egg on the spoon, so he decides to cheat by using some of Bob's putty!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Bob is tiling a roof red, but a mix up at JJ's yard leads to Wendy tiling the other side green!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: When Mr Sabatini recieves a new football, he demonstrates his soccer skills to Dizzy. But he manages to kick the ball through his shop window! Bob and JJ have to carry a new window pane through town.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Roley must rescue Bird to save the day.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Spud jumps in a puddle & ruins Bob's paint job.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: After seeing a poster for the school play, Spud decides he's like to be a musketeer. He decides a fence post would make a perfect sword. But when he pulls one out, all the sheep escape!

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 6 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: It's Wendy's birthday, but she doesn't want any fuss like a surprise party. So Bob organises a surprise magic show instead.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Mr Beasley makes some new friends.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: JJ loses his new remote control plane - only for it to be found by Spud.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Molly sees a family of otters by a stream. Trix wants to watch them too, but they are scared when they see a big shiny machine. Muck devises a good way to watch them.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Skip is moving too quickly & is causing trouble for the gang.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Mr Ellis has a beautiful exhibition that gets ruined.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Bob has promised to build a cat flap for Pilchard. But first Farmer Pickles needs a fence building to keep the rabbits off his cabbages. However, this blocks the badgers' path to the stream.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Bob and the machines are building an exercise park which famous goalkeeper David Dixon, Mr Dixon's brother, is to open. Bob and Spud think they are no good at football, but will their luck change?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Dizzy goes on a camping trip.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Pilchard meets some tiny creatures & treats them like pets.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Scoop is keen to enter the snowman competition. But first a burst pipe outside Mr Sabatini's needs fixing. Meanwhile, all the snowmen's noses are disappearing.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Bob is building a through-lounge for Mr and Mrs Bentley. He asks Lofty to carry the long metal girder. But when Dizzy and Trix decide to have a race, the girder accidentally damages the sides of a bridge.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Hamish gets a new home.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 7 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Dizzy acts like a sheepdog to help Farmer Pickles.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Bob takes a picture of the town.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Mr Bentley has some toy trains that are special to him.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Wendy goes out for a night on the town.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Muck is in a racing mood.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Mr Beasley plays the bagpipes & they're very noisy.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Lofty imagines being in the jungle.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: When Bob gets secret dance lessons from Mrs. Percival, Bob realizes that he can't dance the Salsa, until he and Wendy learned that they must build an outdoor dance floor.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Molly hosts a fashion show but it goes wrong.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Spud's having some bird trouble.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Molly wants to be a doctor.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Mr. Bentley is stuck dogsitting. But, the dog runs off. Will Mr. Bentley find him in time?

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Travis is having a lucky day.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 8 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Farmer Pickles has a new family of pigs delivered to his farm, and Bob must build a new home for them.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Scoop is busy helping Bob and doesn't have time to learn to dance for a special dance display.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Bob volunteers to look after the farm while Farmer Pickles takes Humpty to a pig show but he soon has his hands full when all the animals escape.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Mr Bentley is put in charge of the winter fair but everything gets into chaos when Humpty escapes his pen.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Wendy decorates the library, and Lofty is so impressed that he decides to paint a picture as well, but he soon finds that being an artist is harder than it looks.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Spud breaks Molly's statue, so he tries to make a new one out of Bob's building materials only to leave Bob without the wood to fix the pavilion.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Pilchard causes havoc on a job to mend a rotten beam in a cottage when she finds some mice living there.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Trix tries to help Bob build a climbing frame while she also is looking after Farmer Pickles' giant pumpkin pie but Spud almost gets it.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Bob and the team are repairing an eroded river bank in the countryside when Muck tries to bring a lost duck he/she named Quack back to his family.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Lofty and Travis pull down a damaged tree, only to find that they have made a family of squirrels homeless! Travis is devastated, but suddenly he has an idea which Bob could use the old tree to build a new home for the squirrels.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Bob's gang builds a summer house as an anniversary present for Mrs. Bentley, but Muck nearly ruins the surprise.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Skip wishes he could come up with good ideas, while Bob is renovating the old mill.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Bob and the gang convert a house into a delicatessen, but there's nothing for Roley to do. Fortunately, some birds give him an idea to make him feel useful again.

episodes_data.title: Bob the Builder Season 9 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Bob builds a cinema, and a fake giant bug is sent to promote a new film. However, Trix causes chaos in the town when she borrows the insect to help Spud scare the birds who thinks it is real.
